title: mariscus micranthes
intro: Mariscus micranthes, commonly known as the Sensitive Fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion, thanks to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Mariscus micranthes include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
